## Testing

release-please wrote this PR from the commits since the last tag; it changes only VERSION, .release-please-manifest.json and CHANGELOG.md. CI runs the `lint`, `test` and `secrets` jobs on it, and `scripts/merge-pr.sh` waits for them.

## Risk

Low: no code changes. Merging it tags the release, creates the GitHub release and publishes the runner image under the version (`.github/workflows/release.yml`).

## How to revert

Before merging: close the PR; the next push to main reopens it. After merging: delete the GitHub release and its tag, then revert the merge commit. Published image tags stay until deleted from the package.
